modifiers

Controls used to shape, move, recolor, and animate Nada Vfx effects.

Position

Moves an effect relative to the weapon or runtime effect root.

10 effects

Rotation

Rotates an effect relative to its local attachment.

9 effects

Scale

Changes the overall size of the effect.

10 effects

Hue

Shifts the effect's color while preserving the original visual where possible.

10 effects

Luminance

Adjusts the perceived brightness of the effect.

10 effects

Energy

Controls particle intensity for effects that expose an energy-style control.

6 effects

Lifetime

Changes how long emitted particles stay alive.

6 effects

Simulation Speed

Changes how quickly supported particle systems simulate.

5 effects

Length

Adjusts the longitudinal span of supported effects or Orbital paths.

8 effects

Width

Adjusts the lateral width of supported effects.

3 effects

Count

Controls how many Orbital visuals are active.

4 effects

Speed

Controls movement speed along an Orbital path.

5 effects

Spacing

Controls separation between Orbital visuals or followers.

4 effects

Radius

Controls the radius of an Orbital path.

5 effects

Cycles

Controls path repetition/turning behavior for Orbitals.

4 effects

Drift

Adds movement lag or drift instead of perfectly rigid following.

5 effects

Snake

Enables the existing snake-style Orbital path behavior.

2 effects

Glue

Lets supported Orbitals follow the Orbs motion source.

1 effects

Spin

Enables continuous spin on supported Orbital visuals.

1 effects

Spin Speed

Controls the speed of the spin modifier.

1 effects

Spectrum

Enables the Strands spectrum/rainbow behavior.

1 effects

Spectrum Speed

Controls how quickly the Strands spectrum animation changes.

1 effects

Drag

Enables the Outer Flames drag behavior.

1 effects
